product.document_type: Supplier PURITY base-oils brochure / typical properties

api_group.printed_text: PURITY L60 listed in GROUP II TYPICAL PROPERTIES table
api_group.calculation_note: Grade-specific Group II classification verified in Petro-Canada's official brochure. Group II+ is a broader family designation and is not specifically assigned to L60.

chemistry.value: Hydrotreated/hydrocracked paraffinic and cycloparaffinic mineral hydrocarbons
chemistry.printed_text: HT Purity Process: severe hydrotreating/hydrocracking, dewaxing and hydrofinishing

open_questions: API Group II verified from Petro-Canada's official World-Class Base Oils brochure; the original 2015 brochure did not explicitly classify L60.
Sulfur, Noack, saturates, aromatics and CCS are not reported for L60 in the cited brochure.
Grade-specific SDS and other brochure editions require reconciliation.
